messages:
maria-ops: Morning all — quick async stand:
- Yesterday: validated canary on us-west (small traffic), ran eval suite.
- Blocker: flaky GPU node in the Dedicated pool causing intermittent OOMs.
- Today: triage GPU node + hold rollout until green. Pinging @brianna-sre and @alex-eng.

brianna-sre: On it. Checking node logs now — saw OOMs + kernel OOM messages around 03:12 UTC. Will attempt drain + repro on a small instance. ETA ~30m.

alex-eng: If we need to rollback I can trigger canary rollback and keep new model at 0% while we investigate. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/canary-rollback :thumbsup:

kevin-ml: Quick note — v2.1 perf looked good in lab. Did we enable kv-cache warmup and prefix caching for canary? That affects memory profile.

maria-ops: We enabled warmup but not prefix caching for safety. @kevin-ml can you confirm if enabling prefix cache is safe for v2.1 in prod?

kevin-ml: Confirmed warmup enabled. Prefix cache should be okay but uses ~200MB per active session. I'll run a 15min perf sweep and post numbers.

sam-product: Heads up — customer "Nexus" reported a minor tokenization mismatch in chat with v2.1 earlier today. Not a blocker for rollout but filed issue #452 to track.

brianna-sre: Started drain on suspected host. Reproduced OOM on a smaller repro instance with synthetic load. Collecting heap and dmesg, will attach logs to the incident thread.

maria-ops: Thanks. Pausing rollout for now. If brianna gives a clear green we resume canary at 5%. If OOM persists we rollback — @alex-eng please be ready to execute.

deploy-bot: Scheduled window check at 10:30 UTC. Canary rollout paused by maria-ops. Will post status updates.

maria-ops: Thanks team — will follow up in 45m with decision. If anyone needs access to repro cluster ping me.
